zuregex

zuregex is the PCRE2 regular expression library, packaged twice: as R functions that do what base R’s perl = TRUE engine cannot, and as a C library that other packages link to.

  • For package authors: PCRE2 through LinkingTo, one version on every platform, with a JavaScript dialect.
  • For speed: a compiled-pattern cache, OpenMP matching and captures filled in C.
  • For what base R lacks: PCRE2’s full replacement language and per-call match limits.

zuregex is under development and has no functions yet.

Installation

You can install the development version of zuregex from GitHub with:

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zuregex")
